title: Model Session Drawings
description: Charcoal and pencil drawings from live model sessions, ranging from long shaded poses to quick gesture studies focused on posture and proportion.
content: Charcoal and pencil drawings from live model sessions. Some are longer poses with more detail and shading; others are quick gesture studies, a few minutes each. Most figures have no facial detail — the focus stays on posture and proportion.

images.alt: Charcoal drawing of a figure seen from behind, with strong contrast between light and shadow
images.caption: Expressive Charcoal Drawing: Figure from behind, heavy charcoal, strong contrast between light and shadow.

images.alt: Pencil drawing of a reclining figure in three-quarter view, shaded with crosshatching
images.caption: Reclining Nude: Longer pose, three-quarters view, crosshatching for depth and muscle definition.

images.alt: Three quick gesture sketches of seated and standing figures, lightly shaded
images.caption: Triad of Gestural Poses: Three quick sketches — seated and standing figures, light shading, minimal line work.

images.alt: Three gesture studies of the same figure in different poses, drawn in clean lines
images.caption: Varying Poses of Female Forms: Three gestural studies, each a different pose. Clean lines, light shading on proportion and curve.

images.alt: Four quick gesture drawings: standing, seated, leaning and reclining poses
images.caption: Dynamic Gestures: Four quick poses — standing, seated, leaning, reclining. Fluid lines, very little shading.
